method: Every ACCEPTED output in the six live captures, screened by `summarise.py --additions` (sentences under 0.50 of the transcript's content words: 20 flagged), plus a grep for the prompt's own example content and for any sentence about the speaker's memory. Each hit read by hand against its raw transcript. A fabrication reusing the speaker's own words can escape both screens, so this is the set FOUND, not proved exhaustive. Labelled 2026-09-21 in answer to CodeRabbit's review of PR #583.

notAdditions: The other flagged sentences are faithful paraphrases, each checked against its raw: D6 `on fera un point` (raw: `on fait un point`), D5 `Vas-y, faisons ça` (a repair of `let's go`), and six 6-unscripted sentences restating what the speaker said (`intéressant`, `améliorer l'expérience`, `gratuits`, `pas naturel`, `voir tout ça`, `découper les paragraphes`). Also D7 `Il faut que je logue ces rejets` — faithful in content, though it moves `on` to `je`. No addition was found in any macOS 26.5.1 capture.
